chasing - dory underwater drone flash pa.description: Are you ready to dive into everyday underwater exploration with the CHASING Dory Underwater Drone Flash Pack? As the world's smallest, smartest, and most affordable underwater drone, DORY invites you to discover the hidden wonders beneath the waves. Designed for use in calm waters, DORY is perfect for exploring tranquil lakes, serene coastal areas, and other peaceful aquatic environments. Avoid swift currents and heavy surges to ensure the best experience.The DORY's Wi-Fi Buoy offers seamless wireless connectivity to your mobile device or tablet from up to 50 feet away. This buoy connects to the drone via the included 50-foot tether, granting you ample freedom to explore underwater landscapes. Compact and portable, DORY is smaller than a standard sheet of paper and fits easily into a backpack, making it an ideal travel companion. Weighing 56% less and being 65% smaller than its predecessor, the GLADIUS MINI, DORY is both lightweight and easy to transport.Operating DORY is a breeze with its intuitive controls. The drone's angle positioning feature allows you to tilt it up to 45 degrees up or down, providing a comprehensive view of the underwater world. The Depth Lock function ensures stable exploration at your chosen depth, enhancing your underwater experience. Powered by an internal 4800 mAh battery, DORY offers up to one hour of exploration on a full charge. Simply ensure your smartphone or standalone remote is charged to control the drone.Capture the vibrant underwater life with DORY's built-in true color restoration algorithm, which delivers photos and videos with dynamic, true-to-life colors. The 1080p f/1.6 camera opens up new frontiers of exploration, allowing you to see what others cannot. Illuminate your underwater journey with two 250-lumen headlights, designed to light up the depths without disturbing marine life.DORY's dual play mode enables two users to operate the drone simultaneously one managing its movements and the other controlling the camera. The CHASING DORY app transforms your smartphone into a smart controller, allowing you to manage diving, tilting, depth lock, and camera settings effortlessly. With its hydrodynamic design, DORY combines essential features in a sleek, compact body, and setup takes just minutes.Customize your visual effects with 19 image filters and simple video editing tools, then share your underwater adventures quickly and easily on platforms like Facebook, Instagram, and YouTube. The CHASING Dory Underwater Drone Flash Pack is your gateway to capturing and sharing the breathtaking beauty of the underwater world.
